title: Stop Saying "Very Tired"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very tired". Try one of these instead:
• Exhausted: exhausted after the marathon
• Drained: drained after a long meeting
• Worn out: worn out after moving house
• Shattered: shattered after a night shift
• Weary: weary after a long journey

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
